meta_tags.title: Test Site For Analyzer Tool Demo
meta_tags.description: This is a demo test page used to validate the SEO and Security analyzer tool end to end.

checks.label: Title Length
checks.message: Title length (32 chars) is within the ideal 30-60 char range.

checks.label: Description Length
checks.message: Description length (88 chars) is within the ideal 70-160 char range.

checks.label: Open Graph Tags
checks.message: Missing Open Graph tags: image, url.

checks.label: H1 Tag
checks.message: Multiple H1 tags found (2); a page should generally have exactly one.

checks.label: Image Alt Attributes
checks.message: 1 of 2 images are missing alt attributes.

checks.label: robots.txt
checks.message: robots.txt found and does not block the entire site.

checks.label: sitemap.xml
checks.message: sitemap.xml is valid XML and references 1 entries.

checks.label: HTTPS
checks.message: Site is not served over HTTPS.

findings.note: Missing. Mitigates XSS and data-injection attacks by restricting allowed content sources.
Missing. Forces browsers to use HTTPS, preventing SSL-stripping attacks.
Missing. Prevents the page from being embedded in a hostile <iframe> (clickjacking).
Missing. Prevents MIME-type sniffing that can lead to drive-by downloads/XSS.
Missing. Controls how much referrer information is leaked to other origins.
Missing. Restricts which browser features/APIs (camera, geolocation, etc.) the page may use.

checks.label: Cookie Security
checks.message: No cookies were set on the initial response.

recommendations.title: Serve the site over HTTPS
recommendations.description: The site is not using HTTPS at all, exposing all traffic to interception.

recommendations.title: Add the Content-Security-Policy header
recommendations.description: Missing. Mitigates XSS and data-injection attacks by restricting allowed content sources.

recommendations.title: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header
recommendations.description: Missing. Forces browsers to use HTTPS, preventing SSL-stripping attacks.

recommendations.title: Reduce to a single H1
recommendations.description: 2 H1 tags found; consolidate to one per page.

recommendations.title: Add alt text to images
recommendations.description: 1 of 2 images are missing alt attributes, hurting accessibility and image SEO.

recommendations.title: Add the X-Frame-Options header
recommendations.description: Missing. Prevents the page from being embedded in a hostile <iframe> (clickjacking).

recommendations.title: Add the X-Content-Type-Options header
recommendations.description: Missing. Prevents MIME-type sniffing that can lead to drive-by downloads/XSS.

recommendations.title: Add the Referrer-Policy header
recommendations.description: Missing. Controls how much referrer information is leaked to other origins.

recommendations.title: Add the Permissions-Policy header
recommendations.description: Missing. Restricts which browser features/APIs (camera, geolocation, etc.) the page may use.
